Implement polished empty and loading states:
- Loading skeletons for all data sections
- Empty state illustrations and messages
- "No agents running" → "Spawn First Agent" CTA
- "No tasks yet" → "Create Task" CTA
- Error states with retry buttons

Use shadcn Skeleton component. Create consistent empty state component.

title: Dashboard Foundation: Cost Data Hooks
description:
Create React hooks for fetching cost data:
- useCostSummary() - fetches get_cost_summary
- useCostRecords(filters) - fetches get_cost_records with filtering
- useAgentBudget(agentId) - fetches check_agent_budget
- useSessionBudget(sessionId) - fetches check_session_budget

Include caching, refetch intervals, and error handling. Use TanStack Query or SWR pattern.

title: Dashboard Foundation: Metrics Data Hooks
description:
Create React hooks for fetching metrics:
- useMetrics(periodHours) - fetches metrics_get
- useAgentMetrics(agentId) - fetches metrics_agent_report
- useTaskMetrics() - derived from task list

Include automatic refresh and aggregation helpers.

title: Dashboard Foundation: Install and Configure Recharts
description:
Set up Recharts for dashboard visualizations:
- Install recharts package
- Create chart theme matching RAPID design system
- Create reusable chart wrapper components
- Configure responsive containers
- Set up color palette for consistent styling

Document chart component usage patterns.

title: Dashboard Foundation: Stat Card Component
description:
Create reusable StatCard component for KPI display:
- Large numeric value with formatting (currency, percentage, number)
- Label text
- Trend indicator (up/down arrow with percentage)
- Optional sparkline
- Loading skeleton state
- Consistent sizing and styling

Props: value, label, trend, trendDirection, format, loading
